ActionEvent.title: ActionEvent
ActionEvent.description: An action was proposed. It waits for a PIN; nothing has run.

decided_by.title: Decided By
decided_by.description: Who confirmed or cancelled it, from the audit log.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending, executing, executed, failed, cancelled or expired.

confirm_roles.title: Confirm Roles
confirm_roles.description: The roles that may confirm this action: actions.tools.<name>.confirm_roles in ira.yaml, or else actions.confirm_roles.

can_confirm.title: Can Confirm
can_confirm.description: Whether the caller may confirm it: their credential has the actions permission and their role is in confirm_roles. A missing PIN is not counted here; GET /v1/me/pin says that.

id.title: Id
id.description: The session's id (ses_...). Not a credential.

current.title: Current
current.description: True for the session making this request.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: The browser's User-Agent at sign-in, cut to 200 characters; null when none was sent or the session is older than this field.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Continue a conversation; omit to start a new one.

action.description: An action proposed in this turn, waiting for the PIN.

tools_used.title: Tools Used
tools_used.description: The names of the tools called, in order. Kept for v0.1 clients; tool_calls has the details.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: Each tool call in this turn, in order.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique within the turn: the model's own call id (the transcript's tool_call_id), with a suffix such as -2 if the model repeated one.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: The arguments the model passed, as a JSON object; {} when they were not valid JSON.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: False when the call failed: arguments that were not valid JSON or did not fit the tool's schema, an unknown or switched-off tool, or an error from the tool. Proposing an action is ok.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result the model was given, as text (usually JSON), cut to its first 500 characters. Errors read {"error": "..."}.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when result was cut; it then ends with "…".

AskToolCall.title: AskToolCall
AskToolCall.description: A tool the model called while answering, and what it got back.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The first thing the user said, cut to 120 characters.

model.title: Model
model.description: provider:model that answered; null if none did.

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent
DoneEvent.description: The turn is over. Always the last event.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: A sentence for people; a list of field errors on 422.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description:
Every error: 400 bad input, 401 no or bad credential, 403 not allowed,
404 not found, 409 conflict, 410 gone, 422 invalid body, 429 too many tries.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: No model could answer. A done event follows.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Only its hash is stored.

path.title: Path
path.description: Open this path on the server to accept the invitation.

use_cookie.title: Use Cookie
use_cookie.description: true: an HTTP-only session cookie (browsers). false: the session token in the response body (other clients).

content.title: Content
content.description: For role tool: the tool's result as JSON text.

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call Id
tool_call_id.description: For role tool: the call this answers.

name.title: Name
name.description: For role tool: the tool's name.

cooling.title: Cooling
cooling.description: Models on a cool-down: seconds left.

id.title: Id
id.description: The conversation_id: send it to /v1/ask to continue.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where it started: web (signed in) or api (a token).

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The first thing you said, cut to 120 characters.

MyConversationRow.title: MyConversationRow
MyConversationRow.description: One of the caller's own conversations from the web chat or the API.

since.title: Since
since.description: Start of today, server local time (epoch seconds).

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions people asked today, on every channel: the user turns stored since the start of today. A bare PIN typed into chat is never stored or counted.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Model calls today. One question can make several (one per tool round), and model tests count too.

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: Model calls today that failed: no model in the chain answered, or a stream broke off.

can_confirm.title: Can Confirm
can_confirm.description: The role has the actions permission.

locked_seconds.title: Locked Seconds
locked_seconds.description: Actions are locked after wrong PINs, for this long.

in_use.title: In Use
in_use.description: Named by a tier or by voice, so it is built at start-up.

key_present.title: Key Present
key_present.description: Whether the key's variable is set. Never the value.

session_token.title: Session Token
session_token.description: Only when use_cookie is false. Send as a Bearer token.

id.title: Id
id.description: The session's id (ses_...). Not a credential.

current.title: Current
current.description: True for the session making this request.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: The browser's User-Agent at sign-in, cut to 200 characters; null when none was sent or the session is older than this field.

SessionView.title: SessionView
SessionView.description: A signed-in session that has not expired or been ended.

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: How many sessions were signed out.

code.title: Code
code.description: Printed by `ira serve` while no user exists.

setup_code.title: Setup Code
setup_code.description: Printed in the server log while no user exists.

shorten.title: Shorten
shorten.description: Strip markdown and cut long answers.

StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent
StreamEvent.description: One server-sent event from POST /v1/ask/stream, told apart by `type`.

order.title: Order
order.description: The same models in a new order; null resets.

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: The chain as ira.yaml lists it.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: The chain in use, after any saved reordering.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Only its hash is stored.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: JSON text exactly as the model produced it.

confirm_roles.title: Confirm Roles
confirm_roles.description: Action tools: the roles that may confirm them.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique within the turn: the model's own call id (the transcript's tool_call_id), with a suffix such as -2 if the model repeated one.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: The arguments the model passed, as a JSON object; {} when they were not valid JSON.

ToolEvent.title: ToolEvent
ToolEvent.description: The model called a tool; a tool_result event with the same id follows.

id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the tool event this answers.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: False when the call failed: arguments that were not valid JSON or did not fit the tool's schema, an unknown or switched-off tool, or an error from the tool. Proposing an action is ok.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result the model was given, as text (usually JSON), cut to its first 500 characters. Errors read {"error": "..."}.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when result was cut; it then ends with "…".

HTTPBearer.description: An API token or a session token.
